name: interpolate
description: CC and Macro ramps: with Config > Project Settings > FX Interpolation > MIDI CC / Synths on, a CC FX (a-f) on a MIDI or synth track ramps to the next step on that track with the same FX, instead of jumping there

branches.note: app_audio_block: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600aa858); then the CC ramp pass, once per audio block
render loop: bl seq_advance (veneer 0x600bc2d8); then the ramp pass, so renders ramp too
Config menu constructor: Project Settings folder, room for one more item
Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); then adds the FX Interpolation folder (MIDI CC, Synths) to Project Settings
save request 0x60114e34, Save As only: bl strncpy(fm+0x340, name, 0x21) -> mt_ip_save_name (the settings go with the project to its new name)

words.note: Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_ip_pattern_update (settings file load/save)
Config screen vtable: update method 0x600c6475 -> mt_ip_config_update (settings file load/save)
